definitions.gloss: casual clothes; everyday clothes; informal wear
definitions.explanation: Clothing worn for daily life and relaxation, as opposed to formal or work attire.

examples.japanese: {普段着|ふだんぎ}で{来|き}てください。
{休日|きゅうじつ}は{普段着|ふだんぎ}でのんびり{過|す}ごす。
examples.english: On holidays, I relax in casual clothes.

examples.japanese: パーティーだけど{普段着|ふだんぎ}でいいと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: I was told that casual clothes are fine for the party.

notes:
USAGE:
Used to distinguish informal daily wear from formal attire ({正装|せいそう}) or work clothes ({仕事着|しごとぎ}). A practical, everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普段着|ふだんぎ}で{出|で}かける (to go out in casual clothes)
- {普段着|ふだんぎ}のまま (still in casual clothes, as one is)
- {普段着|ふだんぎ}に{着替|きが}える (to change into casual clothes)

FORMS:
{普段|ふだん} (usual, everyday) + {着|ぎ} (wearing, clothes). The き becomes ぎ due to rendaku.
